const cmds = [
  {
    cmd: `python3 -B -c '
from pathlib import Path
import json, re, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "tools")
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.lint import MARKUP_RE, AT_TOKEN_RE
base = "002717bf5064508c8803b9b73c3f7ea28f887d28"
work = json.loads(Path(".ai/task/repair-w54-20260929/WORKSET.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["items"]
allowed = {(i["normalized_path"], i["section"], i["source"], i["source_tag"]): i for i in work}
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
changed = []
files = []
placeholder_re = re.compile(r"%[-+ #0]*\\\\d*(?:\\\\.\\\\d+)?[cdeEfgGiouXxqs%]")
for name in ("mod-tome.lua", "tome-orcs.lua"):
    old_bytes = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{base}:{name}"])
    old_doc = loader.load_bytes(old_bytes, logical_path=name)
    new_doc = loader.load_path(Path(name), logical_path=name)
    assert len(old_doc.records) == len(new_doc.records), (name, len(old_doc.records), len(new_doc.records))
    file_changes = 0
    for old, new in zip(old_doc.records, new_doc.records):
        old_cmp = {k: v for k, v in old.items() if k != "line"}
        new_cmp = {k: v for k, v in new.items() if k != "line"}
        if old_cmp == new_cmp:
            continue
        key = (name, old.get("section"), old.get("source"), old.get("source_tag"))
        assert key in allowed, key
        assert {k: v for k, v in old_cmp.items() if k != "target"} == {k: v for k, v in new_cmp.items() if k != "target"}, key
        item = allowed[key]
        assert old["target"] == item["target_preimage"], item["entry_revision_identity"]
        assert placeholder_re.findall(old["target"]) == placeholder_re.findall(new["target"])
        assert MARKUP_RE.findall(old["target"]) == MARKUP_RE.findall(new["target"])
        assert AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(old["target"]) == AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(new["target"])
        old_lines, new_lines = old["target"].split("\\\\n"), new["target"].split("\\\\n")
        assert len(old_lines) == len(new_lines)
        assert [i for i, line in enumerate(old_lines) if line == ""] == [i for i, line in enumerate(new_lines) if line == ""]
        assert [len(line) - len(line.lstrip("\\\\t")) for line in old_lines] == [len(line) - len(line.lstrip("\\\\t")) for line in new_lines]
        assert old["target"].endswith("\\\\n") == new["target"].endswith("\\\\n")
        changed.append({"revision_key": item["entry_revision_identity"], "path": name, "line": new["line"], "before": old["target"], "after": new["target"]})
        file_changes += 1
    files.append({"path": name, "baseline_record_count": len(old_doc.records), "current_record_count": len(new_doc.records), "changed_target_count": file_changes})
assert len(changed) == 2, len(changed)
assert {x["revision_key"] for x in changed} == {i["entry_revision_identity"] for i in work}
print(json.dumps({"verified": True, "baseline_commit": base, "files": files, "changed_target_count": len(changed), "non_target_field_change_count": 0, "newline_checks_pass": True, "tab_structure_unchanged": True, "changed": changed}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
'`,
    workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
    yield_time_ms: 30000,
    max_output_tokens: 18000,
    sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated",
    justification: "允许我用仓库 manifest 配置的 LuaJIT 对基线与当前两个译文文件做全记录语义比较吗？"
  },
  {
    cmd: "git diff --check",
    workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
    yield_time_ms: 30000,
    max_output_tokens: 4000,
    sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated",
    justification: "允许我运行只读的 git diff 空白检查吗？",
    prefix_rule: ["git", "diff"]
  },
  {
    cmd: "python3 -B tools/i18n lint --strict",
    workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
    yield_time_ms: 30000,
    max_output_tokens: 8000,
    sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated",
    justification: "允许我运行本轮译文必需的严格 lint（可能写入已忽略的 .artifacts 报告）吗？",
    prefix_rule: ["python3", "-B", "tools/i18n", "lint"]
  }
];
const rs = await Promise.all(cmds.map(x => tools.exec_command(x)));
rs.forEach((r,i) => text(`--- check ${i+1} exit=${r.exit_code} ---\n${r.output}`));
